'''Sage Town''' (Japanese: '''セージタウン''' ''Sage Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Sinnoh]]. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in the [[region]], it is home to a [[Contest Hall]].

It was mentioned in ''[[DP055|Throwing the Track Switch]]'' during [[Marian]]'s news report about {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s. She announced that {{si|Kenny}} had won his second {{pkmn|Contest}} [[Ribbon]] in Sage Town with the help of his {{TP|Kenny|Prinplup}}.
